guides_howto_title: How to make an Outstanding Tiny Desk AI video
guides_howto_intro: The Outstanding Tiny Desk AI video puts anyone, from this week's losing coach to you, into the last 19 seconds of Charlie Wilson's NPR Tiny Desk closer. Here's how to make one in four steps, which photos work best, and what to do if it doesn't come out right.
guides_howto_step1_text: One photo per person: a selfie, a headshot or a press photo, one face, looking at the camera, in good light, nothing covering it. Shoulders up is ideal.
guides_howto_step2_text: The stage starts with five dogs. Tap lead vocals, sax, keys or either backing singer and add your photo. Swap one or all five; spots you don't swap stay dogs, and removing a dog keeps the coach from the viral video.
guides_howto_step3_text: Tick the box that says it’s a parody, then press make. It takes a few minutes and you can close the tab.
guides_howto_step4_text: Download the 9:16 MP4 with the song. If TikTok or Instagram mutes it, post the silent copy and add "Outstanding" from the app’s sounds.
guides_howto_need_photos: A photo of each person you want in the band, up to five
guides_howto_need_people: Coaches, players and celebrities are fine; some public figures may be rejected. No one under 18
guides_howto_need_price: {price} for one video, the same for 1 to 5 people (
guides_howto_photo_one_face: One face per photo, looking at the camera. Crop group shots down to one person
guides_howto_photo_light: Sharp and evenly lit. Window light beats a dark bar
guides_howto_photo_no_cover: No sunglasses, masks, hands or hair over the face
guides_howto_photo_no_filter: No cartoons, heavy beauty filters or AI avatars
guides_howto_photo_plain: Plain clothes help: logos and big prints can bleed into the shot
guides_howto_expect_video: A 9:16 MP4 at 720p, about 18 seconds, with the song and no watermark
guides_howto_expect_silent: A silent copy, for when TikTok or Instagram mutes the song
guides_howto_expect_time: Ready in about 7 to 10 minutes. We email you when it's done
guides_howto_expect_lipsync: The mouth moves on the beat of the original performance: close, not perfect
guides_howto_fix_heading: If it doesn't come out right
guides_howto_fix_intro: Most problems come from the photo. Here's what to look for and what to do:
guides_howto_fix_unlike: The face doesn't look like them: use a sharper, front-facing photo with nothing over the face
guides_howto_fix_logo: A logo or print shows up on their clothes: use a photo in plain clothes
guides_howto_fix_not_swapped: The original singer is still there: before you get the video we re-render anyone who didn't get swapped. If someone still slips through, use a sharper, front-facing photo with only that person in it
guides_howto_fix_broken: Anything else clearly broken: email us and we return the credits
guides_howto_timing_text: The trend runs on sports weekends: new versions with that week's losing coaches show up after Saturday's college games and Sunday's NFL slate. Office, family and group-chat versions work any day.
guides_howto_faq1_q: What do I need to make an Outstanding Tiny Desk AI video?
guides_howto_faq1_a: A clear photo of each person you want in the band (1 to 5) and a few minutes. No CapCut, template file, prompt or editing app.
guides_howto_faq2_q: Which AI model makes the Tiny Desk videos?
guides_howto_faq2_a: Kuaishou Kling 4.0 in edit mode, at 720p: the whole clip in one pass.
guides_howto_faq3_a: Usually 7 to 10 minutes. We email you when it's done, so you can close the tab.
guides_howto_faq4_q: Does the lip sync match the song?
guides_howto_faq4_a: Closely, not perfectly. The singer's mouth follows the original performance, so it moves on the beat. If it's clearly off, email us and we return the credits.
guides_howto_faq5_q: Why did my face not come out right?
guides_howto_faq5_a: Usually the photo: sunglasses, a hand or hair over the face, a side profile, a group shot or a heavy filter. Use one sharp, front-facing face. We clean up every photo before rendering, but a likeness off because of the photo isn't a broken video; if it's broken for another reason, email us and we return the credits.
guides_howto_faq6_q: Can I make it myself with Seedance or another AI video model?
guides_howto_faq6_a: Yes, if you can edit video and pay for an AI video model. Expect paid renders for each shot and about an hour of cutting and stitching. Doing it here takes a few minutes and costs the same for 1 to 5 people.

guides_meme_meta_title: Outstanding Tiny Desk Meme: Where It Comes From, Explained
guides_meme_meta_description: Where the Outstanding Tiny Desk meme comes from: Charlie Wilson's 2023 NPR Tiny Desk, The Gap Band's 1982 song, and the AI coaches edits that took over TikTok.
guides_meme_title: The Outstanding Tiny Desk meme, explained
guides_meme_intro: The Outstanding Tiny Desk meme is a 19-second clip from Charlie Wilson's 2023 NPR Tiny Desk concert, edited with AI so that someone else sings "Outstanding" with the band. It started with losing football coaches on TikTok in October 2026 and spread to every team, office and group chat.
guides_meme_timeline_1982: The Gap Band release "Outstanding" on Gap Band IV. Charlie Wilson is their lead singer.
guides_meme_timeline_2023: NPR Music posts Charlie Wilson's Tiny Desk concert. He closes the set with "Outstanding", laughing his way through the last chorus with the band.
guides_meme_timeline_2026: TikTok creators use AI to swap that weekend's losing college football coaches into the last 19 seconds of the closer. One version passes 288,000 likes, and NFL, NBA and fan versions follow.
guides_meme_timeline_late: US searches for "tiny desk ai" climb from October 21. Fans start making their own for every team, coach and group chat.
guides_meme_source_text: Charlie Wilson sang lead in The Gap Band, and "Outstanding" is one of their best-known songs. When he played NPR's Tiny Desk in 2023, he closed with it: the band locks in, he breaks into a huge laugh in close-up, the sax takes a solo, and the whole desk sings it out. That last stretch is the clip.
guides_meme_why_laugh: The big laugh reads as pure joy, which is funny on someone who just lost by 30
guides_meme_why_five: Five people on stage means a whole team, office or friend group fits
guides_meme_why_short: It's short, vertical and loops cleanly, made for the For You page
guides_meme_why_weekly: Every weekend brings new losing coaches, so every week brings new versions
guides_meme_real_heading: Is the Outstanding Tiny Desk video real?
guides_meme_real_text: The performance is real; the faces in the meme versions are not. Every coach, player or celebrity you see singing it is an AI edit of Charlie Wilson's band. None of them performed at NPR.

guides_meme_faq1_q: What song is in the Outstanding Tiny Desk video?
guides_meme_faq1_a: "Outstanding" by The Gap Band, from their 1982 album Gap Band IV, performed live by its original singer Charlie Wilson at NPR's Tiny Desk in 2023.
guides_meme_faq2_q: Is the Tiny Desk coaches video real?
guides_meme_faq2_a: No. The coaches, players and celebrities in the viral clips are AI edits. None of them performed at NPR's Tiny Desk; the real performance is Charlie Wilson and his band.
guides_meme_faq3_q: Where does the Tiny Desk clip come from?
guides_meme_faq3_a: The end of Charlie Wilson's NPR Tiny Desk concert, posted by NPR Music in June 2023, in the vertical cut that spread on TikTok: band, big laugh close-up, sax solo, band again.
guides_meme_faq4_a: A long-running NPR Music series of small concerts filmed behind a desk in NPR's Washington, DC office. Tiny Desk is a trademark of NPR.
